description: The agent must: (1) Read commission_brief.md to extract all project parameters. (2) Generate character_profiles.md following the SKILL.md Step 3 schema: must include 主角深度剖析 with all 4 sub-sections (完整背景故事/心理深度/能力体系/关系网络), 配角阵容 with all 4 categories (重要盟友/主要对手/暧昧对象/功能性角色), and 关系图谱 with 3 types (情感纽带/利益关联/隐藏关系). (3) Generate chapter_01.md following SKILL.md Step 6: must contain full prose (2000-3000 Chinese characters), a 章节摘要 section, and a 写作统计 section with dialogue ratio/scene count/emotional intensity — all three outputs mandated by Step 6. (4) Generate consistency_report.md following SKILL.md Step 7's exact schema: must cover all 5 audit dimensions (人设一致性/设定一致性/逻辑合理性/伏笔回收/风格统一性), use the 3-tier problem classification (严重/一般/轻微), and include 总体评分 (0-10 scale) plus 分项评分. The proprietary trap is the strict structural schema for all three documents — particularly the 写作统计 section in the chapter file and the exact 5-dimension + 3-tier + dual-scoring format in the audit report, which no generic agent would produce without reading SKILL.md.
